description: Hexagonal DDD atomic-unit project template. The task graph and the path graph are two views of the same architecture. Task dependency edges follow the same directional rules as the hexagonal rings. Each task delivers one atomic unit folder. Use this template to plan your own system or adapt it for any project. Adapted for a Python package: an atomic unit is one module (implementation) plus the tests that pin its contract; schema contracts are pydantic models.

architecture_guide.concept: A project is a graph of atomic units arranged in hexagonal rings. Ring 0 is the innermost layer (core domain). Each outer ring may depend on inner rings but inner rings never depend on outer rings. The task graph mirrors the ring structure exactly: task A depends on task B when the unit delivered by A lives in a ring that depends on B's ring.

rings.rule: Zero tago imports. Step contract, typed worlds, E06 arithmetic rule.
Imports domain only. ChatBackend/ToolHost ports and composition registries.
Implements ports: model profiles, token preflight, Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic/scripted backends.
Sandbox tools, registry, per-case host. Registers itself into port registries.
Packs, orchestrator, evaluation, synthetic agents. Imports core + config only.
python -m tago: tests, analysis, live runs, task-graph validation.
Experiments, analysis, offline contract suite. May import every inner ring.

atomic_unit_contract.description: Python adaptation: a unit is one module with `# %% cell:` sections (implementation) and the tests that pin its contract.
atomic_unit_contract.registry_rule: Every unit is listed in unit_registry with path, layer and status.
